summary: Restart test supplies a valid credential with run=session-exists(rc0) and asserts AUTH_FILE=reference + MODE=enforced unchanged, rejecting a refuse-when-session-exists impl (paired with 49.6 gating refusal on credential absence); entrypoint test parametrizes start/host/quickstart and proves each routes into _ensure_integrated_auth. Real credential reuse, only the tmux probe faked — genuine, not tautological.
